profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering
profile.summary:
With over two years of work experience, I am a passionate and driven software engineer who strives to create scalable and efficient solutions for data scraping, synchronization, and transformation. I have a B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering from UC Merced, and I am currently working as a software engineer at LinkedIn, one of the world's leading platforms for professional networking and career development.

In my previous role as a software developer at General Motors, I developed a proof of concept data scraping application that extracted, transformed, and loaded structured owner's manual documents from an existing service to a centralized knowledge repository, maintaining the data synchronized. I used agile methodologies to advance my own user story and delegated tasks to ensure that the acceptance criteria were met promptly. I also worked collaboratively with the quality assurance team by executing manual test cases, identifying issues, and carrying out component testing with 100% efficiency. I leveraged my skills in C++, Java, and software development to deliver high-quality and innovative solutions that met the client's needs and expectations.

positions.title: Operational Technology Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed a scalable application for Gallo using OOP
methodologies, enabling the synchronization of data tags through multiple servers, efficiently reducing manual the process and time to insert and rename tags by more than 50%.
Documented the development process and assembled a road-map for future expansion for further automation using a web-form.
Set up a development server for AngularJS application using IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, and FactoryTalk Batch API to diagnose/debug a broken feature outside of production.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · Python

positions.title: Operational Technology Intern
positions.description:
Managed company-wide data dashboards to promote the transition of automated reports from 3 different development servers to their production servers.
Utilized the company’s resources to data-mine & document the full stack implementation of a Work Order Management system and update the existing warehouse pump network system interlocks for a capital project.
Collaborated with Senior Engineer to develop Gallo’s corporate variable naming convention and updated Livingston’s data infrastructure to support the new standard, saving the company over $30,000 in licensing.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Ladder Logic · HMI Design

company.name: UC Merced Dining Services - The Summits Marketplace

projects.title: School Grades REST API
projects.description:
Designed and Developed a School grading back-end with the Spring Framework
using Dependency Injection, Inversion of Control, Aspect-Oriented Programming, and Automated Testing design patterns.
Utilized Hibernate Annotations to map POJOs for data persistence and facilitate queries through the use of JPQL.
Created a RESTFUL web service API allowing third-party applications to make calls using JSON objects.

projects.title: Snake Game: Leonidas Edition
projects.description: Using C++ as well as OpenGL and libSOIL API's we developed a Snake Game for our final class project. Using Object-Oriented Approaches we had learned throughout the semester, we were careful in implementing the game as we wanted a final product that kept track of high scores, current score, and ran as the original Snake Game with a few minor changes that we decided to add ourselves.
